findings.title: Container is Zarr v3; full Zarr feature surface in scope unless disallowed
findings.claim: OME-Zarr 0.5 is implemented on Zarr format version 3; codecs, chunk grids, chunk key encodings, data types and storage transformers may all be used unless explicitly disallowed.
findings.condition: Unless explicitly disallowed by the OME-Zarr specification.

findings.title: Metadata lives in zarr.json under the ome namespace; version consistent per hierarchy
findings.claim: OME-Zarr 0.5 metadata is stored under the namespaced key 'ome' in zarr.json attributes; ome.version (string) MUST be consistent within a hierarchy; image groups carry 'multiscales' and optionally 'omero'.

findings.title: Dimensionality 2-5 and type-ordered axes
findings.claim: Multiscale image arrays have 2-5 dimensions (MUST NOT exceed 5); axes MUST be ordered time, then channel/custom, then space; zyx spatial ordering is SHOULD for anisotropic stacks.
findings.obligation: established obligation (MUST for dims/order; SHOULD for zyx)

findings.title: Pyramid level identity is positional (datasets list), not nominal
findings.claim: Resolution levels are separate arrays with arbitrary names; datasets[].path MUST be ordered largest (highest resolution) to smallest; level order comes from the multiscales metadata, not the array names.
findings.obligation: established obligation (MUST ordering); level-choice policy is a product decision (informative example L388-L397 only)

findings.title: Three image-discovery families: plain groups, bioformats2raw.layout=3 collections, HCS plates
findings.claim: Image listing must cover: (a) plain multiscales groups; (b) transitional bioformats2raw collections (layout value MUST be 3; series list ordered as OME-XML images; consecutively numbered groups 0,1,2,... when no series and no plate; OME/METADATA.ome.xml SHOULD exist and MUST use MetadataOnly; readers SHOULD surface multiple images, SHOULD NOT default to the first; plate takes precedence when plate key present); (c) HCS plates with MUST groups plate/row/well, plate columns/rows/version/wells, well images list, 0-based consistent indices, sparse plates legal (empty rows/wells SHOULD NOT be present).
findings.condition: Each sub-rule holds under its stated condition (series present/absent, plate present/absent, multiple acquisitions, etc.).
findings.obligation: mixed: MUST structure + SHOULD reader behavior + MAY choices

findings.title: dimension_names integrity check
findings.claim: 'dimension_names' MUST be included in the zarr.json of each multiscale-level array and MUST match the axes metadata names; axes length MUST equal array dimensionality.

findings.title: Axes: name MUST + unique; type/unit SHOULD with MAY custom types
findings.claim: Each axis MUST have a unique name; type SHOULD be space/time/channel but MAY be any custom string; unit SHOULD be a UDUNITS-2 string (valid space/time unit lists enumerated); unknown axis types must not imply rejection.
findings.condition: Custom unit/type values conform; missing unit is conforming.
findings.obligation: MUST name/length; SHOULD type/unit; MAY custom types

findings.title: Coordinate calibration: per-level scale (exactly one) + optional translation after scale + optional top-level transforms applied after
findings.claim: Each dataset MUST have coordinateTransformations containing exactly one scale (physical pixel size or time duration; relative-factor fallback defaulting 1.0 when scaling unavailable for an axis); only translation/scale types; translation MUST follow scale; vector lengths MUST equal axes count; multiscales-level transforms MAY exist and are applied after the per-level ones; lists apply sequentially in order.
findings.condition: Relative-factor fallback applies only where scaling information is unavailable for an axis.

findings.title: omero is optional/transitional; channels color+window MUSTs conditional on presence; rdefs example-only
findings.claim: If omero is present it MUST contain channels; each channel MUST have 6-hex color and window with min/max/start/end. Per-channel label/active/coefficient/family/inverted and rdefs (defaultT/defaultZ/model) appear only in the example; display defaults are therefore not guaranteed; window semantics beyond L429-L430 defer to uncaptured OMERO docs.
findings.condition: All MUSTs conditional on omero being present.
findings.status: supported (with normative-status uncertainty on rdefs -> U3, U4)

findings.title: Label overlays: discovery via labels key; integer dtypes; equal scale-level count; color/alpha display
findings.claim: labels group zarr.json MUST list label image paths (all SHOULD be listed); label pixels MUST be integer dtypes; intermediate groups MUST NOT contain metadata; label image MUST implement multiscales with the same number of scale levels as the source image; image-label SHOULD exist; readers SHOULD display using colors entries (label-value MUST be integer; rgba MAY, four ints 0-255, fourth = alpha); properties/source MAY; source.image default '../../'.
findings.condition: Color-display SHOULD binds only where image-label.colors is provided; rgba optional per entry.
findings.obligation: mixed: MUST structure/dtype/level-count; SHOULD discovery/display; MAY rgba/properties/source

findings.title: Label-image alignment limits
findings.claim: Label dimensions may equal the image dimension or be 1 (irrelevant); coordinate-system identity with the source image is stated as 'usually', not MUST; overlays must be resolved through the label's own multiscales/coordinateTransformations.
findings.condition: Applies to conforming files; pixel-exact alignment cannot be assumed universally.
findings.obligation: limit/counterevidence to a naive alignment assumption

findings.title: Normative force: RFC 2119; examples informative
findings.claim: MUST/SHOULD/MAY etc. per RFC 2119; all text normative except explicitly non-normative sections, examples and notes; e.g. the multiscale-entry selection pseudocode is example guidance.
findings.condition: Within the normative parts of S003.

findings.title: JSON comments forbidden in real metadata
findings.claim: Example JSON comments are for clarity only; comments MUST NOT be included in JSON objects; comment-bearing zarr.json is malformed input for a reader.
findings.condition: Applies to data files; the spec document itself may show comments.
findings.obligation: established obligation (MUST NOT, writer-side; reader-side malformed-input trigger)

findings.title: Transitional metadata: reading may be a MUST/SHOULD duty; writing optional
findings.claim: Implementations may be expected (MUST) or encouraged (SHOULD) to support reading of transitional metadata (bioformats2raw.layout, omero); writing is usually optional (MAY).
findings.obligation: interpretive rule raising the priority of SS-A5b/SS-B3 for a read-only viewer

findings.title: Storage-agnostic layout transfers to local disk under an assumption
findings.claim: The hierarchy may appear locally, on HTTP, or object storage; the same node/metadata mechanism transfers to Slide Scout's local reading if the local directory behaves as a valid Zarr v3 filesystem store.
findings.condition: Assumption: local FS = valid Zarr v3 store; remote concerns out of product boundary.

findings.title: Version-history compatibility signals
findings.claim: 0.5.0 introduced Zarr v3; 0.5.2 made dimension_names a MUST; 0.5.1 re-added improved omero description; earlier versions (0.1-0.4) had differing layouts (e.g. chunk separator '/', axes added in 0.3/0.4).
findings.condition: Historical record within S003; current-version obligations are those of 0.5.
